analysis.diagnosis: The inner loop is being too aggressive and unfocused. It has found only 3 improvements out of 11 iterations, with the best result achieved early (iteration 4) using only a change to BATCH_SIZE=128, while the initial LR=0.003 was already good. Almost all subsequent attempts add or change multiple parameters simultaneously (especially WEIGHT_DECAY and HIDDEN_DIM) and fail badly, suggesting they are interfering with the already good configuration. LR and BATCH_SIZE have shown some positive signal, while WEIGHT_DECAY and HIDDEN_DIM have been tried repeatedly without a single keep. The search is too broad and erratic, wasting iterations on combinations that produce very high (bad) BPB.
analysis.guidance: Focus only on fine-tuning LR and BATCH_SIZE, starting from the best known configuration (LR=0.003, BATCH_SIZE=128). Vary only one of these parameters at a time, and make small, moderate changes. Do not introduce WEIGHT_DECAY or HIDDEN_DIM as they have consistently degraded performance. Aim for stable iterations that explore near the known good region.
analysis.reasoning: The trace shows that WEIGHT_DECAY and HIDDEN_DIM changes always lead to bad results (>=7 BPB), while LR and BATCH_SIZE have been responsible for the only improvements. Freezing the harmful parameters narrows the search to the promising ones, increasing the chance of finding further improvements quickly. Switching from 'explore' (too broad) to 'focused' (targeted around the best configuration) is appropriate given the clear evidence of which parameters work.
